ceremony.name: Member directory (wallet and community)
ceremony.choreography: docs/31-persona-rooms-elections-ceremonies.md section 5: a member reads the schema and its own card, writes a name, another member (a stand-in for the community's own) browses and reads the entry under the member's visibility, writes a card of its own with its own visibility choices, narrows and hides it; the wallet reads the other member's entry. Negatives: stale revision, non-member, unknown, derived and too-wide fields, replay, tamper, no proof, wrong recipient. The step-down runs against a legacy profile only. Images, groups, connections, introductions, facets and paging are not exercised.

scenarios.title: a member reads the community's directory schema and its own card before it has written anything: the card exists at revision 0, names the required name still missing, and the schema lists the base fields
spec: TF specs/vtc/directory/card/show/0.1/spec.md (consumer items 1 and 3: a card is created for every member, never absent, revision 0; missingRequired names the required fields with no value)
TF specs/vtc/directory/fields/list/0.1/spec.md (consumer item 2: every base field is returned to a member)
